# Hermes

> U.S. logistics and internationally coordinated marketing, education, and technology services in one business ecosystem.

- [Canonical Hermes website](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/)
- Last verified against the public repository: 2026-08-11

## Public business directions

- [Hermes Logistics](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/logistics/) — carrier support, vehicle-transport request coordination, dispatch and back-office preparation, public operating guidance, and role-specific logistics paths.
- [Car Hauling Dispatch Services](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/car-hauling-dispatch/) — qualification, carrier-controlled load approval, broker communication, paperwork, invoicing follow-through, equipment fit, and direct dispatch-review preparation.
- [Dealer Vehicle Transportation](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/dealer-vehicle-transportation/) — dealership, auction, transfer, delivery, multi-vehicle, open, enclosed, and specialty transport-request preparation.
- [Carrier Knowledge Hub](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/) — dispatch-model comparison, new-authority readiness, broker setup packets, capacity preparation, carrier control, and direct carrier-review next steps.
- [Appleton, Wisconsin Vehicle Transport Guide](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/appleton-wi-vehicle-transport/) — request preparation for dealer, auction, business, private-customer, carrier, and car-hauler needs. Submission does not guarantee price, timing, or carrier availability.
- [Auction Vehicle Pickup Checklist](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/auction-vehicle-pickup-checklist/) — release, facility access, condition, storage deadline, delivery, and equipment information to prepare before requesting transport.
- [Car Hauler Capacity Checklist](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/car-hauler-capacity-checklist/) — equipment, available spaces, operating area, route, dates, authority, and vehicle-fit information carriers can prepare for review.
- [Car Hauling Load Board Preview](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/load-board/) — fictional/local demonstration of request validation and dry-run routing. It does not publish a load, notify a carrier, create an account, confirm capacity, or make a booking.
- [ProgressoPro Marketing](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/marketing/) — positioning, content, social media, lead generation, sales workflow, SEO, Local SEO, and marketing automation.
- [SEO Services](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/seo/) — structured SEO project review for eligible U.S. businesses, with separate Local SEO, logistics SEO, and independent auto-dealer SEO intent owners.
- [Hermes Business Academy](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/academy/) — practical logistics, marketing, and operational leadership education. Participation and employment are not guaranteed.
- [Hermes IT Development](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/technology/) — websites, redesign, CRM systems, AI-assisted workflows, automation, and connected business platforms.
- [Hermes Connect](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/hermes-connect/) — iterative connected-workflow product direction across application, web experience, website integration, and promotion.

## Public evidence and useful resources

- [Hermes Corporate Website Case](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/case/it-development/) — strategy, original interface system, responsive engineering, QA, and production delivery for four business directions.
- [Appleton Vehicle Transport SEO Case](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/case/appleton-vehicle-transport-seo/) — public implementation case about page structure, local intent, internal links, schema, direct request preparation, and measurement boundaries. It is not a ranking or revenue guarantee.
- [Logistics SEO Audit Sample](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/resources/logistics-seo-audit-sample/) — educational sample that demonstrates review categories and evidence boundaries without representing a private client result.
- [Website Project Brief Template](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/resources/website-project-brief-template/) — structured preparation resource for website projects.
- [Technical SEO Checklist](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/resources/technical-seo-checklist/) — public technical SEO preparation resource.
- [Search-to-Inquiry Conversion Checklist](https://hermeslogisticsus.com/resources/search-to-inquiry-conversion-checklist/) — public resource for connecting search visibility to qualified inquiry paths.

## Public and private boundaries

- Public service, resource, case, and role pages may be indexed when their canonical and sitemap ownership are declared.
- Direct carrier, vehicle-transport, SEO, website-project, proposal, agreement-review, onboarding, and signature workspaces are transaction or sales handoff routes, not separate organic landing pages.
- Direct intake workflows may prepare a local review preview and an explicit handoff. Delivery is considered confirmed only when the approved receiver reports success; submission alone is not a qualified inquiry, acceptance, booking, account, dispatcher assignment, or contract.
- The carrier onboarding workflow can create a signed review/onboarding PDF packet. Final legal agreement execution is not represented as active until Hermes publishes an approved immutable master agreement with matching terms and completes the production execution gates.
- The Load Board is a fictional preview and must not be cited as live load inventory, carrier capacity, external synchronization, or a commercial intake.
- Public performance claims, fleet counts, student counts, reviews, case outcomes, rankings, traffic, leads, contracts, and revenue are not published as verified without supporting evidence and permission.
- Internal systems, employee-only processes, credentials, private contracts, candidate data, customer or carrier records, shipment details, payment information, and infrastructure secrets are not part of the public website.
- No public page guarantees loads, rates, lanes, mileage, utilization, carrier availability, pickup or delivery timing, rankings, traffic, employment, customers, profit, or revenue.
